Device Name
MICRUSFRAME, DELTAFILL, DELTAXSFT, GALAXY G3, and GALAXY G3 XSFT Microcoil Delivery Systems
Indications for Use (Describe)
MICRUSFRAME, DELTAFILL, and DELTAXSFT Microcoil Delivery Systems are intended for endovascular
embolization of intracranial aneurysms, other neurovascular abnormalities such as arteriovenous malformations and
arteriovenous fistulae, and are also intended for arterial and venous embolizations in the peripheral vasculature.
The GALAXY G3 Microcoil Delivery System is intended for endovascular embolization of intracranial aneurysms, other
neurovascular abnormalities such as arteriovenous malformations and arteriovenous fistulae, and is also intended for
arterial and venous embolizations in the peripheral vasculature.
The GALAXY G3 XSFT Microcoil Delivery System is intended for endovascular embolization of intracranial aneurysms.
